title: explain
summary: Explains one lint rule in plain words: what it means, why it matters, a bad and a good example, its default, whether it can be fixed, and how to suppress it
intro: Read this when a finding names a rule id and you want to know what it is for before you fix it or suppress it: explain prints the meaning, the reason, an example, the default, fixability and the exact suppress line, as text or JSON.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint explain <rule-id> [--json|--format json] [--rules-dir <dir>]   (what one lint rule means, why it matters, bad / good example, default, fixable, and how to suppress it; an unknown id lists the nearest ids and exits 2)
help: drag-lint explain <rule-id> [--json|--format json] [--rules-dir <dir>]   (what one lint rule means, why it matters, bad / good example, default, fixable, and how to suppress it; an unknown id lists the nearest ids and exits 2)

questions.ask: What does this rule mean and how do I silence it?
Give me the explanation as data.
